tools.name: apply_changes
tools.description: Apply an ordered batch of concrete operations to the slicer. Stops at the first failing operation and reports what was applied. The result has before (mode, profile, overrides, extruder materials and objects taken before the batch) and state (after the batch); compare them to say what changed.

kind.description: Operation kind. Required fields by kind: select_mode(mode); select_profile(profile_id); select_material(material_id, extruder); set_global_setting(key, value); set_extruder_setting(key, value, extruder); reset_overrides(keys); import_model(path); open_3mf(path, import_as); transform(object_id, frame, and at least one of position_mm, rotation_deg, scale; rotation_center when rotation_deg is set); duplicate(object_id, count); arrange(object_ids optional); delete(object_ids); set_object_extruder(object_id, extruder): the extruder that prints the object, see objects[].extruder; save_profile(name).

value.description: New setting value in the unit reported by search_settings.

path.description: Local path of an attached model file from the context attachments list.

frame.description: Coordinate frame. scene: build-plate frame in millimetres, origin at the plate center, x right, y back, z up. Position is the bounding-box center.

rotation_deg.description: Absolute orientation relative to the imported orientation: extrinsic X-Y-Z Euler angles in degrees about build-plate axes.

scale.description: Absolute scale factors relative to the imported size, applied along the object's local axes; prefer a uniform scale.

explanation.description: Short reason for the batch, shown to the user on the confirmation card.

tools.name: search_settings
tools.description: Search available slicer settings with types, units, constraints and current values.

tools.name: inspect_profile
tools.description: Selected profile, available quality types, custom profiles and user overrides. Current values of all enabled settings are in the context.

tools.name: inspect_material
tools.description: Facts from the material description in the slicer.

tools.name: inspect_scene
tools.description: Current scene state after changes: printer, mode, profile, materials, overrides, objects with positions and sizes, slice state and errors.

tools.name: analyze_geometry
tools.description: Numeric geometry analysis of selected objects with units and method limits.

tools.name: render_scene
tools.description: Render an additional isometric image of the scene.

tools.name: slice
tools.description: Slice the current scene and save G-code and 3MF into the chat folder.

tools.name: read_document
tools.description: Read an attached document as text: DOCX (headings, lists, tables as Markdown, embedded images returned as images), XLSX (sheets as Markdown tables), CSV/TSV, TXT, MD, JSON, PDF (text layer only; scanned PDFs report an error). Long text is paged: repeat with start = next_start.

path.description: Local path of a document attachment from the context attachments list.

start.description: Character offset to continue from (next_start of the previous call).

sheet.description: XLSX: one sheet name; all sheets by default.

rows.description: XLSX/CSV: [first, last] 1-based row range; the header row is always kept.

tools.name: load_skill
tools.description: Load the instructions of a skill from the skill catalog in the context. Load the skill that fits the user's task before acting; follow its instructions for the rest of the task.

tools.name: lookup_defect
tools.description: Print defect guide: find defects by a description in Russian or English (or by id) and get their causes, the slicer settings that fix them with direction and a typical step, and the current values of those settings. Settings the slicer does not have are listed in unknown_keys.

query.description: What the user sees, e.g. 'нитки между деталями' or 'holes in the outer wall'.

tools.name: match_materials
tools.description: Filter the materials available in the slicer by requirements using typical reference properties of their polymer family. Returns candidates with passed and failed criteria, materials whose family is unknown, and suitable families the slicer does not offer.

max_temp_c.description: Highest temperature the part sees in service, °C.

flexible.description: true for an elastic part, false for a rigid one.

tools.name: calculate
tools.description: Engineering calculations the slicer does not do. Formulas and inputs: gear_lewis_bending(torque_nm, module_mm, teeth, face_width_mm[, allowable_stress_mpa]); hole_compensation(nominal_mm, measured_mm[, feature hole|outer, current_xy_offset_mm]); part_mass(volume_mm3, surface_area_mm2, wall_thickness_mm, infill_percent, density_g_cm3); rotating_hoop_stress(density_g_cm3, rpm, outer_radius_mm[, shape ring|solid_disk, poisson_ratio, allowable_stress_mpa]); shaft_torsion(torque_nm, diameter_mm[, inner_diameter_mm, allowable_stress_mpa]); thermal_expansion(length_mm, delta_t_c, cte_1e6_per_k). Returns the value with units, the formula, assumptions and a safety factor when allowable_stress_mpa is given.

inputs.description: Named numeric inputs of the formula in the units given by their names.

tools.name: generate_calibration_model
tools.description: Generate a calibration test part as STL in the chat folder and return its path for apply_changes import_model. Kinds: calibration_figure (no params) is the default beginner figure: one fixed part 70x50x27 mm with zones for first layer, overhangs, bridge, stringing towers, holes, thin wall, small spire and top surface; it returns zones with the face to photograph, what to look for, setting_keys and defect_ids, and face labels A-D marked by 1-4 dots. Use the other kinds only to refine one zone around a found threshold: cube(size_mm) for dimensions and first layer; overhang_test(angles_deg, height_mm) for overhang limits; bridge_test(lengths_mm, height_mm) for bridging; stringing_towers(distance_mm, height_mm) for retraction; hole_tolerance(diameters_mm, thickness_mm) for hole accuracy and horizontal expansion.

params.description: Optional parameters of the kind; defaults are used when omitted.

tools.name: calibration_journal
tools.description: Calibration attempt journal kept in the chat folder. record: save one printed attempt with the geometry (kind and params passed to generate_calibration_model), per-zone observations from the photos, the planned setting changes and the lesson; call it before apply_changes so printed_with captures the settings this attempt was printed with. New photos in the chat are attached automatically. It does not change settings. read: all attempts and a comparison of the latest attempt with the previous one of the same geometry: zones fixed, persisting and new, and the settings changed between them.

kind.description: record: the generate_calibration_model kind that was printed.

params.description: record: the params passed to generate_calibration_model; omit for calibration_figure.

figure_path.description: record: path of the printed STL.

observations.description: record: one row per inspected zone.

zone.description: Zone id from the zones list, e.g. overhangs.

changes.description: record: planned setting changes to apply next with apply_changes.

after.description: New value in the unit reported by search_settings.

lesson.description: record: one sentence the user learned from this attempt.
